title: Funding impact summary kit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for a funding impact summary in a grant renewal: the grant period's results compared with the original targets, spending by budget line taken word for word from the finance lead's figures, missing numbers kept as unknown, and a traceable summary draft, while the finance lead checks the figures and the executive director approves and submits.
boundaries: Use only synthetic, clearly marked test data.
Steps marked for a person never go to an agent.
Outputs stay surface_only in the requester's scope.
Importing the pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for a grant renewal funding impact summary agent kit

value.lets_workers: Compare a whole grant period's program results with the targets in the original agreement, take spending by budget line only from the finance lead's figures, and draft the renewal application's impact summary with every number traced to its source. The finance lead checks every figure, and the executive director approves the summary and submits the renewal.
human_only: Check every figure against the books and program records.
Approve the summary and how shortfalls are explained.
Submit the renewal application to the funder.
rules: Use only synthetic, clearly marked test data. Never put a real person's details into the kit, a test case or an output.
Steps marked for a person stay with people. The agent drafts or helps; it never decides about a person and never contacts anyone.
Tools are read-only. Anything that changes records outside the requester's scope is a person's step.

provenance_notes.note: The marketplace's example of this kit. It holds only the catalog's own fields and points at this pack's kit and need nouns by value digest, so the kit has one source.

One recorded example run of the kit on a desktop computer with synthetic data: check, build and independent review with the marketplace's own pipeline, zero model calls. Not a hosted run or an evaluation.

nouns.title: Funding Impact Summary for Grant Renewal Kit
nouns.category_reason: The agent's whole setup as one noun: its step map and pins to every part.

value.summary: Summarizes what a grant paid for and achieved over its whole period for a renewal application: results against the original targets, spending by budget line from the finance lead's figures, and lessons staff name. Missing numbers stay unknown, and staff approve and submit.
value.goal: Help a small nonprofit summarize what a grant achieved over its whole period for a renewal application, with results against the original targets and spending from the finance lead's figures, while the finance lead checks the numbers and the executive director approves and submits.
value.target_org: Small community nonprofit applying to renew a two-year foundation grant

step_map.title: Compare the grant period's results with the original targets
step_map.guidance: Total each measure over the whole grant period, compare it with the original target, and take spending by budget line only from the finance lead's figures. A missing number stays unknown, never zero.

step_map.title: Draft the funding impact summary for the renewal
step_map.guidance: Draft the renewal's sections: what the grant paid for, results against targets, what it cost by line, what staff learned, and what comes next. Every number comes from the period table, and lessons come only from staff notes.

step_map.title: Check every figure against the books and program records
step_map.guidance: The finance lead traces every figure to the organization's books and program records and corrects or removes any that cannot be traced.

step_map.title: Approve the summary and how shortfalls are explained
step_map.guidance: The executive director decides how shortfalls, changes and lessons are explained, and approves the summary.

step_map.title: Submit the renewal application to the funder
step_map.guidance: The executive director submits the renewal through the funder's own portal. The agent never submits or sends anything.

nouns.title: Skill: draft a funding impact summary from a period table

value.name: impact-summary-drafter
value.description: Drafts a grant renewal's funding impact summary from a period results table, keeping every number traceable and every gap visible.
value.instructions: Use the funder's renewal sections and word limits. Take every number from the period results table and cite its measure or budget line; spending figures are the finance lead's, word for word. Write missing numbers as not yet counted. Describe what the grant paid for and what was done and counted, and never claim a result the table does not show. Take lessons and next steps only from staff notes. Keep participant stories out unless staff supply an approved, de-identified one.
refuses: Inventing or estimating a missing number
Changing the finance lead's spending figures
Claiming results the records do not show

nouns.title: Synthetic test cases for the funding impact summary kit

cases.scenario: Two-year grant with every period reported and most targets met
cases.sample_input: SYNTHETIC: Grant period 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31 with 8 quarterly results tables. Targets: 480 households served, 96 workshops. Totals: 512 households, 90 workshops. Finance lead's spending: staff USD 61,000, supplies USD 18,400.

cases.scenario: One quarter's results are missing and one measure is well below target
cases.sample_input: SYNTHETIC: The results table for 2026 Q2 is missing; workshops total 61 of a 96 target over the reported quarters.

verbs.title: Compare the grant period's results with the original targets

slots.name: targets
slots.description: Pin of a noun holding the original grant agreement's measures and targets.

slots.name: period_results
slots.description: Pin of the program's results tables for every reporting period of the grant.

slots.name: finance_figures
slots.description: Pin of a noun holding the finance lead's spending by budget line for the grant period.

steps: Total each measure across every reporting period with the pinned read-only tool.
Compute percent of target only when both the target and the total are known.
Copy spending by budget line from the finance lead's figures unchanged.
Keep every missing number null, and list the period it is missing from.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.period-table's schema.
Every total equals the sum of its measure across the pinned period results.
Every spending figure equals the finance lead's figure for that line.
Every missing number is null and listed in missing.
